# Technology-Driven Supply Chain Solutions Built Around Your Business

Today's supply chains require more than disconnected services. Powered by proprietary digital
platforms, AI-enabled intelligence, automation, and the expertise of our people, Ryder helps you
navigate complexity with greater visibility, control, and confidence. From fleet leasing and
maintenance to dedicated transportation, transportation management, freight brokerage, warehouse
management, contract packaging and manufacturing, e-commerce and omnichannel fulfillment, and
last-mile delivery, we deliver connected port-to-door solutions designed to keep your supply chain
moving and your business ahead.

عربية وبرؤية ثاقبة لحكومات الأردن ومصر والعراق

transport. Applying our many years of experience in the production of minibuses to the development
of electric buses, we can now offer extremely high-quality electric city and intercity buses.

Altas Auto ZERO emission buses are based on the Mercedes Benz Sprinter base. We currently offer 2
fully electric models for your selection, which we have precisely developed together with our
partners Elinta Motors.

Ankai New Energy Bus has many characteristics such as safety, environmental protection, economy and
comfort. The world's first pure electric bus line is operated by Ankai Bus
[[Double-Decker Tour Bus]][153]
[Ankai 71 Seat Electric Double-Decker Tour Bus E12S][154]
The Ankai E12S is a 71-seat electric double-decker bus designed for city and sightseeing use.
Powered by dual 95kW motors and a 331.37kWh CATL battery, it delivers strong performance with zero
emissions. Featuring a durable monocoque body, air suspension, and dual-power steering, the E12S
offers a smooth, safe, and comfortable ride for passengers.
[View more][155]
[[sightseeing bus]][156]
[Ankai 12M electric double decker sightseeing bus][157]
Ankai GS series double-deck bus adopts integral body structure to protect the safety of passengers
to the maximum extent.
[View more][158]
[[12m energy city bus]][159]
[Ankai 12M electric city bus][160]
Ankai G9 electric city bus has a smart and lightweight design, spacious and comfortable driving
space, equipped with multiple intelligent driving technologies. 
[View more][161]

Ankai electric G9 has a smart and lightweight design, spacious and comfortable driving space,
equipped with multiple intelligent driving technologies.

the prescribed route with a speed≤40km/h and a lateral error＜10cm.

Ankai is the first company in China to have school bus qualifications, and the first batch of

professional school bus technology of Navistar from the United States.

### Frequently asked questions

What does Auto-CUBY do?

Auto-CUBY is a luxury minibus and bus manufacturer specializing in professional conversions based on
Mercedes-Benz Sprinter and Iveco Daily. We build tourist, city, VIP, and special minibuses - from 8
to 31 seats. The entire design and production process is carried out in Poland at our facilities,
which ensures full quality control.

[Learn more about the company][111]

Can I configure a bus to my needs?

Yes - every bus is configured individually depending on customer needs and intended use. We offer
full customization of conversion and equipment.

The online bus configurator available on model pages allows real-time adjustment - from seat count
to premium equipment.

You can choose, among others, seat count, seat type (standard, adjustable, VIP leather), equipment
(LED lighting, multimedia, tables), luggage space, and additional systems.

It is also possible to match paint and interior finishing to your fleet visual identity, brand, or
specific project.

[Contact us][112]

How many passengers does a minibus carry?

Our capacity range is from **8+1 passengers** (VIP Line) up to **31 passengers** (Tourist Line HD).

What does the ordering process look like?

The bus purchase process at Auto-CUBY includes:
1. **Contact and consultation** - discussion of your needs and business profile
2. **Configuration** - model, seat count, equipment, and premium solutions selection
3. **Quotation and contract** - individual pricing and schedule setup
4. **Production** - conversion carried out at our Polish facilities (from several to over a dozen
   weeks)
5. **Delivery and training** - vehicle handover with full user training
6. **After-sales support** - service, warranty, and technical support

[Start the process - contact us now][113]

Do you provide service and warranty?

Yes - we provide complete after-sales support, service, and warranty for our buses and minibuses.

We have a dedicated after-sales and service department supporting customers both during and after
warranty period.

We also provide access to authorized service points across Europe, which enables safe operation in
international transport.

Mercedes-Benz Sprinter and Iveco Daily. We build tourist, city, VIP, and special minibuses - from 8

Can I configure a bus to my needs?

Yes - every bus is configured individually depending on customer needs and intended use. We offer
full customization of conversion and equipment.

The online bus configurator available on model pages allows real-time adjustment - from seat count
to premium equipment.

You can choose, among others, seat count, seat type (standard, adjustable, VIP leather), equipment
(LED lighting, multimedia, tables), luggage space, and additional systems.

specific project.

[Contact us][112]

How many passengers does a minibus carry?

Our capacity range is from **8+1 passengers** (VIP Line) up to **31 passengers** (Tourist Line HD).

#### Why travel with Blackpool Minibuses?

We’re a local minibus hire company that believes the journey should always be fun. From corporate
transport for schools and businesses, to airport transfers, day trips and nights out, we’re the only
transport operator you need. Our modern and comfortable 8, 14 and 16 seater minibuses come with
fully qualified, fun and friendly drivers to get you to your destination stress free. We have a
large fleet of 30+ minibuses, as well as safe and secure box trailers available, so whether there’s
5 or 65 passengers, we’ve got you covered.

Every single one of our 30+ buses have Bluetooth sound systems installed for your enjoyment, so you
can set the playlist for your journey. We also allow alcohol on board, meaning your adventure begins
from the moment you leave your doorstep. This large fleet also means we always have spare back up
vehicles… we’ve never let a customer down, ever!

We provide minibus hire and taxi transport for the whole of Lancashire, including Blackpool, Lytham
St. Annes, Fleetwood, Preston and Lancaster, for passengers leaving or visiting the area, and we
cover the whole of the UK. Our most popular services include **[airport transfers][110]**, **[day
trips][111]** and [**nights out**][112], but we also specialise in **[school and corporate
work][113]**. Whatever your plan or itinerary, **[get in touch][114]** for a hassle free quote from
our helpful office team.

large fleet of 30+ minibuses, as well as safe and secure box trailers available, so whether there’s
5 or 65 passengers, we’ve got you covered.

can set the playlist for your journey. We also allow alcohol on board, meaning your adventure begins

vehicles… we’ve never let a customer down, ever!

## FAQ: Bus Rental Manila

### How much does it cost to rent a bus in the Philippines?

Check our Bus Rental [**Rates**][12] page to see the Coaster or Tourist bus price to different
destinations from Metro Manila. Or fill the [**bus quotation form**][13] to see the cost to your
desired destination.

### How can I compare quotes from different bus rental companies?

Use our [**bus quotation form**][14], fill in the info accordingly. Keep an eye on the inbox or SMS.
You will get up to 4 quotations from the coach transportation company to compare.

### What’s the difference between a coaster and tourist bus?

Mini bus, Small bus, or Coaster bus capacity is 20, 25, to 28 seater in the Philippines, making it
easier for city or short-distance routes.

Tourist bus or Coach bus capacity is 45 to 50 seater in the Philippines, making it larger with more
luggage room for long distances.

### How much is the 25 seater minibus or coaster bus rental price?

and up, depending on route and distances. See our [**rates**][15] for a complete overview.

### What is the tourist bus rental price in Quezon city?

Tourist or Coach bus rental prices in Metro Manila commonly start around ₱11,500 and up, depending
on route and distances. See our **[rates][16]** for a complete overview.

### How much to rent a bus for a day?

A bus for hire with a driver starts around for a one-way trip. Choose Full Day (Round-trip within
the same day) on the [**bus quotation form**][17] to get your required price.

### What is the mini bus or coaster bus rental price per day?

The price to rent a mini or coaster bus depends on the following packages. On the [**bus quotation
form**][18], fill in the info accordingly to get the required prices.
* One Way (drop-off only)
* Full Day (Round-trip within the same day)
* Overnight (2 days & 1 night)
* 3 Days & 2 Nights
* Other / Over 3 Days / Multiple Itineraries/drop & pick up

### Does bus rental price includes driver meals and accommodation?

Yes — meals and accommodation are included in the price for tourist bus or minibus rental with
driver.

### Do you also provide tourist van rental service?

Yes. We also provide a tour or coaster van for rent, shuttle, or charter van rental services. Or a
20-seater van for rent in the Philippines. See **[Van Rental Manila][19]** for more information.

Use our [**bus quotation form**][14], fill in the info accordingly. Keep an eye on the inbox or SMS.

# Charter Bus Rental in Concord

Get quotes for charter bus rentals in Concord from a network of different bus companies. Compare
instant pricing side by side for groups of any size across Concord, California.

[Get Instant Estimates][4]

## Get Pricing

## How It Works

01
Enter Your Trip Details

Pickup, drop-off, date, passengers, and the vehicles you want priced — 30 seconds.

02
Get Instant Estimates

Price estimates arrive by text and email from independently owned bus companies and booking
companies serving Concord.

03
Find What You're Looking For

Pick the option that fits your group and budget.

## What this service does — and what it doesn't.

This website is a free way to compare charter bus rentals in Concord. Submit one quote request and
compare price estimates from independently owned bus companies and booking companies serving the
area. This website is not a bus company and does not own buses, operate transportation, or perform
trips — the operator you choose provides the bus and driver and confirms availability and final
pricing.

## Common Questions

Is this website a bus company?+

No. This website is a free quote-comparison and referral service — it does not own or operate any
vehicles. Quotes come independently from a national booking company working with local bus companies
serving Concord.

Does it cost anything to get a quote?+

No. Comparing quotes is always free.

How fast do quotes arrive?+

Estimates from participating operators are sent by text and email, usually within minutes of your
request. Enter a valid mobile number and email address to receive them.

Disclosures

carrier and does not own or operate buses or employ drivers. Transportation is provided by
independent transportation providers or affiliate carriers. When you request a quote, your
information is sent to a national booking platform and/or independent third-party operators who
arrange and provide the transportation.

**Consent to contact.** By submitting a quote request, you hereby expressly consent to receive
automated communications including calls, texts, emails, and/or prerecorded messages, and you
authorize this website to share your trip details and contact information with participating
providers or affiliate networks for quote purposes. Consent is not a condition of purchase.

**Pricing.** Any rates, prices, or savings shown are illustrative estimates only and are not
guaranteed. Pricing and availability are provided by the carriers, vary with dates, mileage, trip
length, passenger count, and demand, and are subject to change. Quotes typically include the bus,
driver, fuel, and standard amenities; tolls, parking fees, driver accommodations for overnight
trips, cleaning fees, special event permits, and driver gratuity are not included unless stated by
the provider.

**Vehicles & availability.** Vehicle photos and illustrations are representational only.
Availability, specific models, features, amenities, and final booking terms are confirmed by the
assigned provider and are not guaranteed. Submitting a request does not guarantee that quotes,
vehicles, or service will be available for a given date or location.

**Operators & compliance.** Independent operators are solely responsible for maintaining required
licenses, permits, insurance, and DOT/FMCSA operating authority, and for setting and enforcing
vehicle policies, including any alcohol, age, and conduct rules where permitted by law.

**No affiliation.** This website is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any
transportation company, venue, school, university, military installation, or organization
referenced. All trademarks, service marks, and company names are the property of their respective
owners and are used for identification purposes only.

# Great things happen with the right fleet solutions

EFS and Fleet One solutions by WEX Fleet help owner-operators and major carriers alike run smarter
and more efficiently. Find the fleet solutions you need to stay ahead.

[Get Started][36]
[two men in front of truck]

## Fleet One Solutions

### Competitive discounts for growing fleets

Every dollar you save gives your growing fleet the edge it needs. The Fleet One EDGE Card helps you
save thousands per year in fuel discounts alone, and gives you big discounts on tires, maintenance,
wireless plans, and more.

[Fleet One EDGE Card][37]

## EFS Fleet Solutions

EFS helps freight carriers unlock the value behind payments, so you can focus on making your
business the best it can be. EFS fuel cards set the standard for security and control, with add-on
solutions to improve efficiency and performance based on your exact needs.

## Welcome to EG Truck Services

## Your Trusted Partner for HGV & Commercial Vehicle Maintenance

At EG Truck Services, we specialize in delivering reliable, compliant, and professional services to
keep your fleet on the road. Whether you're managing heavy goods vehicles, light commercials,
minibuses, or horseboxes, our expert technicians are here to support your business with top-tier
care and maintenance.


At EG Truck Services, we bring over 40 years of hands-on experience in the commercial vehicle
industry, offering expert maintenance, inspections, and repair solutions for HGVs, light
commercials, minibuses, and horseboxes.


Based locally near Stafford, we pride ourselves on being a trusted name for reliable, efficient, and
compliant vehicle services. Our team of highly skilled technicians understands the demands of the
transport industry and is committed to helping keep your fleet safe, legal, and on the road.


Over the decades, we've built a reputation for integrity, attention to detail, and quick turnaround
times. Whether you're a single-vehicle operator or managing an entire fleet, we offer a tailored
service that fits your operational needs.


We also arrange local breakdown service recovery – so when things go wrong, you’re not on your own.
With our deep roots in the Stafford area and our longstanding commitment to customer care, we’re
more than just a workshop — we’re your maintenance partner.

keep your fleet on the road. Whether you're managing heavy goods vehicles, light commercials,

commercials, minibuses, and horseboxes.

service that fits your operational needs.


We also arrange local breakdown service recovery – so when things go wrong, you’re not on your own.
With our deep roots in the Stafford area and our longstanding commitment to customer care, we’re
more than just a workshop — we’re your maintenance partner.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently asked questions on bus charter services typically cover topics such as pricing,
availability, booking procedures, amenities, vehicle types etc.

### Have a Question?

Need answers? Ask away – we're here to help!

[ Contact Us ][98]
[ What sizes of mini buses are available for hire?
][99]

Mini buses typically range in size from 15 to 30 seats, catering to various group sizes and needs.

[ What amenities are included in the mini bus hire?
][100]

Amenities vary by provider but commonly include air conditioning, comfortable seating, and sometimes
Wi-Fi and entertainment systems.

[ Do mini bus hire come with a driver?
][101]

Yes, most mini bus rentals include a professional driver who is experienced in navigating different
routes and ensuring passenger safety.

[ What is the cancellation policy for mini bus hire?
][102]

Cancellation policies vary among rental companies. It's essential to inquire about the terms and
conditions regarding cancellations, refunds, and rescheduling.

[ How are the rates determined for mini bus hire?
][103]

Rates typically depend on factors such as rental duration, distance traveled, amenities provided,
and any additional services requested. Getting a quote from the rental company will give you a clear
idea of costs.

[ Are mini buses wheelchair accessible?
][104]

Some mini buses are equipped with wheelchair lifts or ramps. If accessibility is required, it's
important to specify this when booking to ensure the appropriate vehicle is provided.

[ What sizes of mini buses are available for hire?
][99]

Mini buses typically range in size from 15 to 30 seats, catering to various group sizes and needs.

[ What amenities are included in the mini bus hire?
][100]

Amenities vary by provider but commonly include air conditioning, comfortable seating, and sometimes
Wi-Fi and entertainment systems.

[ Do mini bus hire come with a driver?
][101]

Yes, most mini bus rentals include a professional driver who is experienced in navigating different
routes and ensuring passenger safety.

[ What is the cancellation policy for mini bus hire?
][102]

Cancellation policies vary among rental companies. It's essential to inquire about the terms and
conditions regarding cancellations, refunds, and rescheduling.

[ How are the rates determined for mini bus hire?
][103]

Rates typically depend on factors such as rental duration, distance traveled, amenities provided,
and any additional services requested. Getting a quote from the rental company will give you a clear
idea of costs.

[ Are mini buses wheelchair accessible?
][104]

Some mini buses are equipped with wheelchair lifts or ramps. If accessibility is required, it's
important to specify this when booking to ensure the appropriate vehicle is provided.

Relationship with our clients is a Key Focus

process. From the initial build and design stages to the final delivery, we ensure a seamless
journey, keeping you informed at every step.

providing continual support to guarantee the longevity of your investment.

## About Us

"Hire A Minibus With Driver" is a local coach and minibus hire company in the UK operating as a
subsidiary of [HireGo Minibuses][14] (which is among the top-rated minibus and coach hire companies
in the UK, with hundreds of positive reviews on Trustpilot). As the UK's fastest-growing luxury
minibus provider, we prioritise high-quality service, rigorous driver vetting, and a dedicated
support team. 

From weddings to airport transfers or any other special travel plan, we cater to your different
travel needs with the best minibuses and coaches at the [most affordable rates][15]. Our goal is
simple: to transport you to and from any corner of the UK with safety and comfort without putting a
dent in your pocket. 

Now you can also travel with your special requests in a minibus vehicle, including the child seats,
[minibuses with toilets][16], [wheelchair accessible minibus ][17]and many more, with a secure
online payment. No need to stress about searching for transport as we will make all the prompt
arrangements for your upcoming trip.

From England to Scotland and Wales to Northern Ireland, we provide coaches and minibuses all across

## Cheap Prices With Best Quality

Travelling with our minibus is always safer compared to public transport. With an affordable and
upfront quote delivered to your inbox, we value your time and money by calculating the price
according to your exclusive travel requirements. We calculate our prices based on factors such as
journey duration, hire time, vehicle type, and peak season, always bringing you a customer-focused
service.

**Get a personalised quote by filling out a quick form with your journey details for instant booking
and comfortable travel.**

## Short and Long-Term Car Hire Services

We know your transportation needs can vary greatly. That's why we offer flexible options for both
short and long-term hires. 
1. **One-Day Hire:** From weddings to funerals or quick airport transfers, book a comfortable and
   stylish [minibus for the day][27]. Make your special occasions even more memorable with our
   reliable one-day hires.
2. **Multi-Day Tours:** We tailor our multi-day hire options to suit your travel schedule for
   extended family or group excursions throughout the UK. You can focus on enjoying the journey

3. **Contract Hire:** For businesses in need of long-term minibus solutions, our [contract hire][28]
   is the perfect choice. Hire us for corporate transfers, seminars, meetings, and more for luxury

No matter the duration or purpose of your trip, we are your go-to partner for minibus hire that

## About Us

"Hire A Minibus With Driver" is a local coach and minibus hire company in the UK operating as a
subsidiary of [HireGo Minibuses][14] (which is among the top-rated minibus and coach hire companies
in the UK, with hundreds of positive reviews on Trustpilot). As the UK's fastest-growing luxury
minibus provider, we prioritise high-quality service, rigorous driver vetting, and a dedicated
support team. 

From weddings to airport transfers or any other special travel plan, we cater to your different
travel needs with the best minibuses and coaches at the [most affordable rates][15]. Our goal is
simple: to transport you to and from any corner of the UK with safety and comfort without putting a
dent in your pocket. 

Now you can also travel with your special requests in a minibus vehicle, including the child seats,
[minibuses with toilets][16], [wheelchair accessible minibus ][17]and many more, with a secure
online payment. No need to stress about searching for transport as we will make all the prompt
arrangements for your upcoming trip.

## Cheap Prices With Best Quality

Travelling with our minibus is always safer compared to public transport. With an affordable and
upfront quote delivered to your inbox, we value your time and money by calculating the price
according to your exclusive travel requirements. We calculate our prices based on factors such as
journey duration, hire time, vehicle type, and peak season, always bringing you a customer-focused
service.

and comfortable travel.**

## Short and Long-Term Car Hire Services

We know your transportation needs can vary greatly. That's why we offer flexible options for both
short and long-term hires. 
1. **One-Day Hire:** From weddings to funerals or quick airport transfers, book a comfortable and
   stylish [minibus for the day][27]. Make your special occasions even more memorable with our
   reliable one-day hires.
2. **Multi-Day Tours:** We tailor our multi-day hire options to suit your travel schedule for
   extended family or group excursions throughout the UK. You can focus on enjoying the journey
   while we take care of the logistics.
3. **Contract Hire:** For businesses in need of long-term minibus solutions, our [contract hire][28]
   is the perfect choice. Hire us for corporate transfers, seminars, meetings, and more for luxury
   travel and stylish arrival for your clients and employees.

No matter the duration or purpose of your trip, we are your go-to partner for minibus hire that
meets your unique requirements. If you still have questions, you can share them in the booking form,
chat or even on a call, and we will provide real-time support for your journey.

How do I book a ride with King & Queen Limo?

Booking your luxury transportation in NYC with King & Queen Limo is quick and easy. You can reserve
your chauffeured service, Sprinter van rental with driver, executive car service, or charter bus
transportation directly through our website or by calling our dedicated customer service team. Our
specialists are available to help you choose the perfect vehicle for airport transfers, weddings,
corporate travel, private tours, group transportation, and special events. We focus on personalised
service, seamless booking, and premium travel experiences from the moment you contact us.

How do I get a fast quote?

Getting a fast and accurate quote with King & Queen Limo is simple. You can receive an instant
estimate for our luxury transportation services in NYC by using our online quote form or by calling

executive SUVs, sedans, minibuses, and charter buses for large groups. Whether you’re booking
airport transportation, wedding limo service, corporate travel, VIP group transportation, or
long-distance luxury travel, we match you with the perfect vehicle for comfort, style, and
efficiency. All our vehicles are professionally maintained, modern, and designed to deliver a
first-class chauffeured experience.

Are gratuities included in the service price?

your confirmation. At King & Queen Limo, our chauffeur gratuity policy is designed to respect each
client’s individual experience. We believe exceptional service should be rewarded based on the

highest standards of a professional chauffeur service. Any applicable service charges or included
gratuities are always disclosed in advance for complete transparency and peace of mind.

### How Much Does It Cost to Hire a Coach in the UK?

The cost of hiring a coach in the UK varies depending on several factors, including the type of
coach, distance traveled, duration of hire, and time of year. Coach hire services in London offer a
range of options to suit different needs, from standard coaches to luxurious executive coaches. On
average, hiring a standard 16-seater coach for a full day excursions might cost around £400-£600.
Larger coaches, such as a 49-seater, could range from £600-£1,000 for a day. Prices can also
fluctuate based on demand and additional services required, such as a tour guide or special
amenities.

## How to Hire a Coach in London?

Hiring a coach in London involves a few straightforward steps:
1. **Determine Your Requirements**: Identify the size of the coach needed, the number of passengers,
   travel dates, and any special requirements.
2. **Search for Coach Hire Companies**: Look for reputable companies offering coach hire in London
   through online searches or recommendations.
3. **Request Quotes**: Contact multiple companies to request quotes, ensuring to provide all
   necessary details for accurate pricing.
4. **Compare Offers**: Compare the quotes based on cost, amenities, and customer reviews. Consider a
   bespoke service as a tailored option for your specific needs.
5. **Book Your Coach**: Once you’ve chosen a company, finalize the booking by providing any
   additional information and making the necessary payments.

### Can You Hire a Coach Without a Driver?

In the UK, hiring a coach without a driver (self-drive luxury coach hire only) is generally not
possible. Due to the size and licensing requirements for driving a coach, coach hire companies in
London provide a driver to ensure safety and compliance with legal standards.

## How Does Coach Hire London Work?

Coach hire London works by providing a vehicle and driver for a specified journey or period. The
process typically includes:
1. **Booking**: Customers contact a coach hire company, providing details about their trip and
   selecting from options such as luxury coaches for enhanced comfort and convenience. Double decker
   coaches are also available for large groups attending major events in London.
2. **Quote and Agreement**: The coach company offers a quote based on the trip details. Once agreed,
   the customer confirms the booking.
3. **Service Provision**: On the day of travel, the coach arrives at the designated pickup location,
   and the driver ensures the journey is conducted safely and efficiently.
4. **Completion and Payment**: After the journey, any outstanding payments are settled according to
   the agreed terms.

### How Much is Coach Hire for a Day in the UK?

Coach hire for a day in the UK can range from £400 to £1,200, depending on factors such as coach
size, trip distance, and additional services. A small 16-seater might cost around £400-£600, while a
larger 49-seater could be £800-£1,200.

### Is it Possible to Travel to London by Coach?

Yes, it is possible to travel to London by coach travel. London boasts various attractions,
including vibrant art and entertainment facilities, historical and cultural sites popular tourist
destinations, and scenic places.

Numerous coach operators provide services to and from the city of London, offering a convenient and
often cost-effective way to travel. Major companies like National Express and Megabus have regular
routes connecting London with other cities and towns across the UK.

### How Long is a Coach from Manchester to London?

The journey time for a coach from Manchester to London typically ranges from 4 to 6 hours, depending
on traffic conditions and the specific route taken. Some express services might offer shorter travel
times.

### How Much Does It Cost to Hire a Coach in the UK?

The cost of hiring a coach in the UK varies depending on several factors, including the type of
coach, distance traveled, duration of hire, and time of year. Coach hire services in London offer a
range of options to suit different needs, from standard coaches to luxurious executive coaches. On
average, hiring a standard 16-seater coach for a full day excursions might cost around £400-£600.
Larger coaches, such as a 49-seater, could range from £600-£1,000 for a day. Prices can also
fluctuate based on demand and additional services required, such as a tour guide or special
amenities.

## How to Hire a Coach in London?

Hiring a coach in London involves a few straightforward steps:
1. **Determine Your Requirements**: Identify the size of the coach needed, the number of passengers,
   travel dates, and any special requirements.
2. **Search for Coach Hire Companies**: Look for reputable companies offering coach hire in London
   through online searches or recommendations.
3. **Request Quotes**: Contact multiple companies to request quotes, ensuring to provide all
   necessary details for accurate pricing.
4. **Compare Offers**: Compare the quotes based on cost, amenities, and customer reviews. Consider a
   bespoke service as a tailored option for your specific needs.
5. **Book Your Coach**: Once you’ve chosen a company, finalize the booking by providing any
   additional information and making the necessary payments.

### Can You Hire a Coach Without a Driver?

In the UK, hiring a coach without a driver (self-drive luxury coach hire only) is generally not
possible. Due to the size and licensing requirements for driving a coach, coach hire companies in
London provide a driver to ensure safety and compliance with legal standards.

## How Does Coach Hire London Work?

Coach hire London works by providing a vehicle and driver for a specified journey or period. The
process typically includes:
1. **Booking**: Customers contact a coach hire company, providing details about their trip and
   selecting from options such as luxury coaches for enhanced comfort and convenience. Double decker
   coaches are also available for large groups attending major events in London.
2. **Quote and Agreement**: The coach company offers a quote based on the trip details. Once agreed,
   the customer confirms the booking.
3. **Service Provision**: On the day of travel, the coach arrives at the designated pickup location,
   and the driver ensures the journey is conducted safely and efficiently.
4. **Completion and Payment**: After the journey, any outstanding payments are settled according to
   the agreed terms.

### How Much is Coach Hire for a Day in the UK?

Coach hire for a day in the UK can range from £400 to £1,200, depending on factors such as coach
size, trip distance, and additional services. A small 16-seater might cost around £400-£600, while a
larger 49-seater could be £800-£1,200.

### Is it Possible to Travel to London by Coach?

Yes, it is possible to travel to London by coach travel. London boasts various attractions,
including vibrant art and entertainment facilities, historical and cultural sites popular tourist
destinations, and scenic places.

Numerous coach operators provide services to and from the city of London, offering a convenient and
often cost-effective way to travel. Major companies like National Express and Megabus have regular
routes connecting London with other cities and towns across the UK.

### How Long is a Coach from Manchester to London?

The journey time for a coach from Manchester to London typically ranges from 4 to 6 hours, depending
on traffic conditions and the specific route taken. Some express services might offer shorter travel
times.

# Private Minibus Hire With Driver In Manchester

Could not find a wedding theme minibus or an airport transfer for your past-midnight schedule? Our
minibus is the answer to all of your travel plans with a focus on the quality and safety of your
trip. Whether you need a vehicle for students, sports teams or elderly adults, we provide exclusive
minibuses for all kinds of groups. 

Home to football clubs and fascinating architecture, Manchester stands out among the top tourist
cities in the entire UK. Choose our minibus so you never have to worry about travelling on public
transport again. 

Our fleet of vehicles includes cars, 7 to 8 seater MPVs, 9, 12, 16 to 25 seater minibuses, along
with [large coaches][21] of up to 70 seaters. This extensive fleet of vehicles is our commitment to
keep the love and dedication for travel alive among tourists, so everyone can enjoy a memorable
exploration of Manchester.

From Trafford, Stockport, and Tameside to Wigan, Oldham and Bolton, our services span the entire
Manchester area, giving the much-needed relief of optimal transport anywhere, anytime.

**Still have questions? Reach out to us by sharing the travel details in the form above. We will get
back to you right after the submission with a personalised quote and answer your queries.**

Get Your FREE Quote
[null]


## Who We Are?

We are a **private minibus **and **coach hire company in Manchester**, UK. We initiated the minibus
services with one goal in mind: to make travel accessible and comfortable for everyone. Being avid
travellers ourselves, we know the challenges the transport industry is facing and all the harsh
impacts it inflicts on the travel experience. We are here to remove these issues from the root
causes and make travel cost-friendly and well-trusted.

When it comes to the beautiful city of Manchester, good quality transport is crucial to achieving a
better travel experience. We can help with your itinerary, from traffic density to the most
optimised route planning. 

Not just the transport, but also our drivers are the backbone of our operations that deliver
excellence at every mile of your destination. These drivers are troubleshooters to handle any
unexpected situation on the road, so you do not have to stress about any tricky situation. Book our
minibus now to let us make your journey smooth with an upfront quote and competent licensed drivers.

[null]


## What Makes Our Minibuses Affordable In Manchester?

Do not let expensive and grubby transport make your journey around Manchester worse. Hire our famous
minibuses with expert drivers having years of experience and rigorous attention to your itinerary.
Despite the miles, our minibus is cheaper without any compromise on quality. 

This was made possible by allowing your group to travel on a multi-seater minibus instead of hiring
multiple vehicles. Travelling with a group of more than 10 passengers on multiple transports is
always daunting and adds to the cost, which eventually disrupts your budget. However, our minibus
specialises in offering a single-vehicle transfer solution for all the members of the group,
allowing them to split up the cost without breaking the budget. 

With market-competitive pricing and a reliable fleet of minibuses, we push the boundaries of stylish
tours of the city and neighbouring boroughs. So what are you waiting for? Book your minibus now and
bond with your friends and family by travelling together to the same destination.

### PHVC - Who we are

PHVC are an industry leading minibus and van supplier supporting organisations across the UK. For
over 35 years, we have dedicated ourselves to building strong partnerships and delivering
exceptional service to customers in education, business and the community and care sector.

Our extensive experience and commitment to quality have made us one of the most trusted suppliers in
the minibus industry. We put our customers first, providing transportation tailored to meet the
unique needs of every organisation we serve.

### PHVC - What we do

We provide a comprehensive list of vehicles including 9 to 17 seat minibuses and 23 seat
mini-coaches. Over the years, we’ve built longstanding partnerships with the most reliable brands in
the sector including Ford, Vauxhall, Iveco and Peugeot.

Innovation and customer service are central to PHVC. We handle maintenance in-house to ensure
quality control. We’re leading the shift to eco-friendly transportation, collaborating with Ford to
develop the electric eTransit minibus and add to the extensive choice we offer. 

It’s all for you, our customers. No matter the requirement, we are here to meet your needs. Whether
that’s bespoke vehicle requirements, flexible finance options or a drive towards sustainable
transport, we’re here to deliver.

### PHVC - Who we are

PHVC are an industry leading minibus and van supplier supporting organisations across the UK. For
over 35 years, we have dedicated ourselves to building strong partnerships and delivering
exceptional service to customers in education, business and the community and care sector.

Our extensive experience and commitment to quality have made us one of the most trusted suppliers in
the minibus industry. We put our customers first, providing transportation tailored to meet the
unique needs of every organisation we serve.

[Our story][66][Our services][67]

### 35 years of experience

### Trusted industry leaders

### Specialist suppliers

### Experts in transportation

### PHVC - What we do

We provide a comprehensive list of vehicles including 9 to 17 seat minibuses and 23 seat
mini-coaches. Over the years, we’ve built longstanding partnerships with the most reliable brands in
the sector including Ford, Vauxhall, Iveco and Peugeot.

Innovation and customer service are central to PHVC. We handle maintenance in-house to ensure
quality control. We’re leading the shift to eco-friendly transportation, collaborating with Ford to
develop the electric eTransit minibus and add to the extensive choice we offer. 

It’s all for you, our customers. No matter the requirement, we are here to meet your needs. Whether
that’s bespoke vehicle requirements, flexible finance options or a drive towards sustainable
transport, we’re here to deliver.

longstanding partnership. Their reliable service, high quality vehicles and commitment to excellence
ensures our students and staff always have safe, comfortable transportation. We cannot speak highly
enough of PHVC and the service they provide.”

### Mrs N Eglington, Director of Operations, Roedean School

  ever-develop more models in line with the latest technology and market trends, in order to support

  Strong OEM and R&D
  As an OEM, we excel in crafting tailored solutions, leveraging deep expertise & manufacturing
  prowess. Our R&D team, comprised of skilled engineers, integrates cutting-edge tech, ensuring SFYL
  stays at the forefront of innovation. Our golf carts & electric vehicles are advanced yet
  customizable, meeting unique customer needs. Staying ahead of market trends, we empower clients
  with competitive advantages, fostering their business growth and success.
* [STRICT QUALITY CONTROL]
  STRICT QUALITY CONTROL
  Our skilled QC team inspects every aspect of production, leveraging advanced methods and
  equipment. This commitment guarantees compliance with international standards and client
  specifications, earning us a reputation for reliability and trust. SFYL delivers only the finest
  electric vehicles, meeting or exceeding expectations for quality, performance, and durability.

  POWERFUL PRODUCTION
  Backed by a robust manufacturing prowess, we house 6 state-of-the-art factories spanning an
  impressive 45,000 square meters. Equipped with cutting-edge production equipment and boasting over
  30 dedicated production lines, our operations harness the expertise of 1,000 skilled employees.
  This formidable setup ensures unparalleled production capacity and efficiency, positioning SFYL as
  the go-to source for high-quality golf carts with unwavering performance.
* [PROFESSIONAL SERVICE]
  PROFESSIONAL SERVICE
  Offering tailored solutions and personalized support. Our knowledgeable team leverages
  cutting-edge tools to promptly address customer needs, from pre-sales to after-sales.
  Comprehensive training and 24/7 support ensure client satisfaction and long-term success.
* [WARRANTY SUPPORT]
  WARRANTY SUPPORT
  We take immense pride in our product quality and are committed to empowering our clients'
  businesses and facilitating their market expansion. To this end, we offer a comprehensive warranty
  program, tailored to specific models and dealerships, that covers manufacturing defects for 1-3
  years, ensuring our clients' peace of mind and long-term success.

intra-city travel and transportation in metro areas. Requests for buses with specific amenities are

## Hướng dẫn hành khách

Chuẩn bị cho một chuyến đi suôn sẻ với những thông tin cần thiết. Tìm hiểu về các yêu cầu thị thực,
phương tiện giao thông, dịch vụ sân bay và thủ tục an ninh.

[
[Service Image]

### Thị thực

Bạn đang lên kế hoạch cho chuyến đi? Dễ dàng kiểm tra các loại visa, lệ phí và yêu cầu nhập cảnh.

][34][
[Service Image]

### Di chuyển đến & từ sân bay

Các phương tiện di chuyển thuận tiện khi đến và rời sân bay.

][35][
[Service Image]

### Hướng dẫn hành trình

Thông tin và dịch vụ tại sân bay từ lúc làm thủ tục đến khi đến nơi, giúp chuyến đi thuận lợi hơn.

][36][
[Service Image]

### An ninh & Hải quan

Những điều cần biết về soi chiếu an ninh, quy định hành lý và thủ tục hải quan.

][37][
[Service Image]

### Lưu trú

Thông tin các khách sạn, resort nổi tiếng của Phú Quốc, thông tin cần thiết cho du khách khi lưu trú
tại Phú Quốc.

][38][
[Service Image]

### Gợi ý du lịch đảo

Mẹo di chuyển, đổi tiền và trải nghiệm du lịch, nghỉ dưỡng, giải trí trên đảo một cách thuận tiện.

][39]

## Dịch vụ ưu tiên

Nâng tầm hành trình của bạn với các dịch vụ độc quyền được thiết kế để mang lại sự thoải mái và tiện
nghi tối đa, đảm bảo trải nghiệm du lịch suôn sẻ và không căng thẳng ở mọi chặng đường.

[Slide Image Desktop]

### Dịch vụ của Sun PhuQuoc Airways

Từ lựa chọn chỗ ngồi yêu thích, mua thêm hành lý, hay đăng ký các dịch vụ đặc biệt – tất cả đều được
thiết kế để mang đến cho bạn trải nghiệm bay thoải mái, tiện nghi và trọn vẹn nhất.

[Khám phá dịch vụ
][40]
[Slide Image Desktop]

## Kỳ nghỉ Phú Quốc

Khám phá vẻ đẹp, văn hóa và di sản của Phú Quốc. Tận hưởng các tour quá cảnh độc quyền, những điểm
tham quan không thể bỏ qua và dịch vụ visa thuận tiện, mỗi chuyến đi đều mang đến những trải nghiệm
khó quên.

Lưu trúĂn uốngGiải tríMua sắmGolf

Đang tải trải nghiệm...

Câu hỏi thường gặp

Mã quốc tế của Cảng Hàng không Quốc tế Phú Quốc là gì?

Mã Cảng Hàng không Quốc tế Phú Quốc là PQC (theo IATA)

Tôi nên đến sân bay Phú Quốc trước giờ bay bao lâu?

Sân bay Phú Quốc có hỗ trợ hành khách đặc biệt không?

Tôi có thể đổi ngoại tệ sang VNĐ ngay tại sân bay Phú Quốc không?

Khi đến Phú Quốc từ chuyến bay quốc tế, tôi cần làm những thủ tục gì?

Khi bị thất lạc hành lý sau chuyến bay, tôi cần làm gì?

# Надежный транспорт для важных поездок

Аренда комфортабельного 20-местного Mercedes Sprinter с водителем по Владивостоку и краю.

[Оставить заявку][8]

## Преимущества

**Без посредников**

Услуги предоставляются напрямую. Без комиссий и дополнительных наценок.

**Гибкая оплата**

Оплата возможна как наличными, так и по безналичному расчёту для организаций.

**Знание достопримечательностей**

Водитель хорошо знает туристические места Владивостока и Приморского края.

**Профессиональный водитель**

Опытный водитель с большим стажем работы.

**Лицензия**

Деятельность осуществляется на основании официальной лицензии.

## О нас

**Наша миссия — делать ваши путешествия по Владивостоку и Приморскому краю комфортными, безопасными
и незабываемыми. **  Мы предлагаем не просто аренду транспорта, а комплексное решение для вашей
мобильности. Наш флагман — современный и комфортабельный 20-местный микроавтобус Mercedes Sprinter
2019 года выпуска. Это гарантия надежности, плавности хода и достаточного простора для пассажиров с
багажом. Наша специализация — работа с группой.  Мы идеально подходим для: ✅ Деловых
поездок: пунктуальный трансфер для делегаций и корпоративных мероприятий. ✅ Туризма: удобные
маршруты для экскурсионных групп по городу и живописным уголкам края. ✅ Особых событий: организация
трансфера для гостей праздника. ✅ Индивидуальных решений: любые частные и групповые поездки по
вашему маршруту. Во главе угла — профессионализм. Вашу группу сопровождает опытный водитель, отлично
знающий дороги региона.

**Ваше время и доверие — для нас главное!**

## Услуги
* [Трансфер из аэропорта]
  **Трансфер из аэропорта**
  
  Пунктуальный трансфер от аэропорта, вокзала или любого адреса.
  
  Заказать
